widgetTool.name: mobile_handoff
widgetTool.description: Emit a deep-link card to continue the flow in the ACN Bank mobile app (e.g. Apple Pay setup, document upload). Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me give you a link to continue in the app.' Webchat only — on voice, direct the customer to open the app manually.

actionType.description: Required. Always the exact string 'OPEN_URL'. Matches the guard in CardActivationWidget so the same trusted-URL path is reused verbatim.

body.description: One short sentence explaining why the handoff is worth taking, e.g. 'Review, sign, and enable auto-pay in your app.'

cta_label.description: Button label, e.g. 'Continue in the app'.

handoff_url.description: Required. The exact URL to open. Must be https on the trusted host (emvnzir-canada-song.web.app) and must carry loan_draft, customer_id, and sso=web query params.

loan_kind.description: epp | mortgage. Rendered as a small pill.

monthly_payment_cad.description: Repeated on the card so the customer sees what they are handing off.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'mobile_handoff'

title.description: Card header, e.g. 'Finish in the ACN Bank app'.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
